verdict.rationale: Mirroring repositories to and from another Git server is a fair question for a Git hosting platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence contains no GitHub-native mirroring, import, or push/pull-mirror feature. The only related items are generic Git operations (`git remote add`, cloning, forking) and a third-party git-bug sync suggestion; these are user-side workarounds and adjacent features that earn no credit.
